notes:
Seabyss II — Beta 0.1.7-beta.50

- Adds boss mastery progression and validated ship-design unlocks for six World Bosses.
- Expands the Seabyss Encyclopedia and market presentation with new ship-design portraits.
- Adds Cauldron reward history and bulk-processing safeguards while preserving exactly-once delivery.
- Aligns quest prerequisites, catalog balance, NPC quest availability, and respawn behavior with the validated Beta 50 game state.
- Includes deterministic boss-reward queue timing fixes.
- Purchases and all financial gates remain disabled for this Beta release.
